data.description:
## Context
The documentation survey on `minimum-rainy-fawn` and session log `homemade-coltish-donkey` identified seven approved recommendations. The operator approved F08A, F08B, F09, F10, F12, F13, and all three F19 units. Rejected F02, F03, and F04 remain excluded. Deferred F05 remains undecided.

## Plan
- Correct bounded README workflow and installation facts.
- Align operation-certificate and import guidance with current implementations and accepted ADRs.
- Complete ADR 0100 command discovery through the existing route registry.
- Repair MCP summary generation and transition registrar wording.
- Correct the generated configuration contract through three bounded F19 children.
- Change generated artifacts only through their canonical sources.
- Land each child as an independently reviewable Gerrit change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] F08A documents current claim, relation, unlink, help, and close behavior.
- [ ] F08B documents current installation dependencies and Git requirements.
- [ ] F09 distinguishes asymmetric operation certificates from generic and legacy HMAC records.
- [ ] F10 documents import batching, partial results, rerun behavior, and recovery limits.
- [ ] F12 makes every visible top-level route discoverable through supported help forms.
- [ ] F13 emits complete MCP summaries and correct transition semantics.
- [ ] F19A removes the nonexistent MCP configuration-surface claim.
- [ ] F19B generates a public description for every emitted typed configuration key.
- [ ] F19C corrects current configuration history and diagnostic-switch guidance.
- [ ] Every child passes its applicable local checks and both Gerrit gates before merge.
- [ ] The full batch lands on `main` and all descendants close without force.
data.title: Implement approved documentation accuracy batch F08 through F19
